scientific_integrity: The geometric primitive integral torus basis and full 336-element rational symmetry character are the novel claims. Previously known first-homology results and implied Betti ranks are credited to general graph-braid theory; exact integer certificates and a reproducible verifier are supplied. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One canonical fourteen-vertex graph and two unordered particles only
No determination of the fundamental group or cup products
Rational representation decomposition does not assert integral module splitting
No general classification of graph braid spaces is claimed
Residual possibility of unindexed or inaccessible literature
title: Fourteen hexagon-product tori and the full symmetry modules of the Heawood two-particle configuration space
